Remark
[a submersion metric on the frame bundle]

Source: petersen:page-0289 ↗ def:pet-ch6-parallel-field 1. ch6:6.7.28For a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ let $FM\to M$ be the orthonormal frame bundle. Find a Riemannian metric on $FM$ making $\pi :FM\to M$ a Riemannian submersion with fibers isometric to $O(n)$, by declaring parallel orthonormal frames along curves in $M$ to give horizontal lifts.
